name: Sumodir

sources.title: SumoDir pricing — Free (backlink required, 2-week review) / Premium $15 / Review Article $49
SumoDir homepage — business directory for startups, SaaS, local businesses, apps

conditions: Free listing requires a backlink to sumodir.com on your site
Free listings are reviewed and listed within ~2 weeks
requirements: Broad eligibility: startups, SaaS companies, local businesses, and apps
Prohibited: cryptocurrency, adult content, gambling, or illegal services — removed without refund
Free tier description limited to ~1,500 characters
preparation: Website URL, name, description (≤1,500 chars free / ≤2,500 premium), logo, categories/tags
A page where the SumoDir backlink can be placed (free path)
Decide Free vs Premium ($15 one-time) vs Review Article ($49 one-time)
workflow: Place the required backlink to sumodir.com
Manual review lists the site within ~2 weeks; Premium skips the queue instantly
watchFor: Premium ($15) buys instant approval, 3 dofollow links, and an AI-written 2,500-char description with no backlink requirement
$49 Review Article add-on generates a 1,500–2,500-word AI review post with dofollow links
'Promote Your Brand' ad slots ($30/30 days) were marked sold out at fetch time
Checkout via Polar; content-policy removals carry no refund even on paid plans
Cross-promotes a LaunchDirectories done-for-you submission service
countsAsLive: A public item page at sumodir.com/item/<slug> reachable from its category listing.
unknowns: Whether the free listing's outbound link is dofollow only after their backlink is detected
